craft_claim: Consonant self-narration and free indirect style collapse psychic distance so that a character's interiority reaches the reader without an omniscient intermediary.

supporting_evidence.location: Chapters 1-2 on quoted monologue and consonant versus dissonant self-narration
supporting_evidence.note: Cohn classifies narrative modes for presenting consciousness and shows how consonant self-narration fuses the narrating and experiencing selves, minimizing authorial distance.
Existing repo claim establishes that psychic distance can be modulated continuously from detached staging to intense neurological interiority.
Free indirect style merges authorial diction with character idiom, producing intimacy and ironic sympathy at once.

scope: Prose fiction, especially close third and first person.
exceptions: Camera-eye objective narration, which withholds interiority by design and belongs to tone-detached.
